from pathlib import Path
import pytest
from linkwatch.config import load_settings, Settings

# SET A: Compatibility Gate Tests
def test_set_a_load_settings_contract(tmp_path):
    p = tmp_path / 'sites.toml'
    p.write_text('title = "Test"\noutput = "out.html"\n', encoding='utf-8')
    s = load_settings(str(p))
    assert isinstance(s, Settings)
    assert s.title == 'Test'

def test_set_a_site_list_types(tmp_path):
    p = tmp_path / 'sites.toml'
    p.write_text('title = "LinkWatch"\n[[sites]]\nname = "Example"\nurl = "https://example.com"\n', encoding='utf-8')
    s = load_settings(str(p))
    assert len(s.sites) == 1
    assert s.sites[0].name == 'Example'

# SET B: Adversarial Edge-Case Tests (Red Team Fuzzing)
def test_set_b_binary_stream_rb_mode_invariant(tmp_path):
    p = tmp_path / 'sites.toml'
    p.write_text('title = "BinaryModeTest"\n', encoding='utf-8')
    # Standard library tomllib mandates binary 'rb' mode
    s = load_settings(str(p))
    assert s.title == 'BinaryModeTest'

def test_set_b_utf8_multibyte_unicode_and_emojis(tmp_path):
    p = tmp_path / 'sites.toml'
    p.write_text('title = "Café Crème ✓ 🚀"\n[[sites]]\nname = "Café"\nurl = "https://cafe.fr"\n', encoding='utf-8')
    s = load_settings(str(p))
    assert 'Café' in s.title
    assert s.sites[0].name == 'Café'

def test_set_b_malformed_syntax_error_resilience(tmp_path):
    p = tmp_path / 'broken.toml'
    p.write_text('title = "Unclosed String\n[broken', encoding='utf-8')
    with pytest.raises(Exception):
        load_settings(str(p))

def test_set_b_empty_and_default_settings_tables(tmp_path):
    p = tmp_path / 'empty.toml'
    p.write_text('', encoding='utf-8')
    s = load_settings(str(p))
    assert isinstance(s, Settings)
